### Research projects and networks

- **Ecosystem services of sponge-dominated habitats** in northern Patagonian marine wetlands along an urban pollution gradient (PIN2 04/P016, UNCo). Team member, 2026 – present.

- **Spatio-temporal structure of the phytoplankton assemblage of the San Antonio Bay frontal system** (PIN1 04/P007, UNCo). Collaborator, 2024 – 2025.
- **RIDPA** · Fish Diversity Indicators Network of Argentina.

- **Arrecifes & Costas Patagonia** · Patagonian coastal ecology working group. 2022 – present.
